title: Authenticated shared company calendar, separate from personal tasks and ERP

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/2026 identical dates remain separate; shared event appears to both employees, immutable author controls edit/delete.

dnspyEvidence.source: Web-only shared calendar JSON file, fixed authenticated route, no MSSQL or nenova.exe action. Existing lock/CAS primitives reused; ERP tables preserved.

identityNote: ERP identity is the standard preserved-ledger guard; company calendar lookup uses companyIdentity only and never queries these ERP keys.

eventDisplay.title: Existing title is returned in each event for month, week and date projections.
eventDisplay.color: Optional six-digit #RRGGBB input, persisted and returned as lowercase #rrggbb. Omitted create or legacy colorless record uses #267b4c. Omitted update preserves the saved color for older clients.
eventDisplay.storage: Additive event.color in the existing schemaVersion 1 JSON file; no SQL or schema migration. Reads do not rewrite legacy records.
eventDisplay.safety: Existing author/admin permissions, revision CAS, actor-scoped request replay and atomic publication remain in force for color edits.

weeklySeries.input: Optional weekly:{endDate,deadline,inclusive,resetDate}; date is the first range start and endDate is 0-6 days later. inclusive defaults false (deadline itself excluded); true includes deadline. Last range is clipped at the deadline. Optional ISO resetDate must be after date and no later than deadline.
weeklySeries.ordinal: Title must contain exactly one ASCII [0-9]+차 ordinal. Its starting value and final weekly value must be positive safe integers (1..9007199254740991), and every rendered title fits 120 characters. Leading zero width is retained. No duplicate startNumber field.
weeklySeries.storage: One series UUID and original fields in existing schemaVersion 1 JSON; no per-day rows or SQL migration. Only requested month/week/date day union is projected; selected date and existing 1000-event/IPC byte limits remain in force.
weeklySeries.projection: Each occurrence has series id, actual date, incremented title, color, times and edit permission. weekly:{startDate,endDate,deadline,inclusive,resetDate?,title} contains the original series fields for whole-series editing. UI render identity is id + date.
weeklySeries.edits: Series update and delete require recurringEdit:true, otherwise 409 even for authorized older clients. Series update requires weekly fields; conversion between single events and series is rejected with 409. Author/admin, revision CAS and actor-scoped idempotent replay remain unchanged.
weeklySeries.reset: resetWeek=ceil((resetDate-startDate)/7). That weekly range begins a new cycle at ordinal 1 independent of the original title's start number. A mid-range reset date never splits its current range; the next range start resets instead. The reset range start must actually occur before the exclusive deadline or on/before an inclusive deadline; otherwise reject 400. Omission preserves uninterrupted ordinals. Maximum ordinal/title length is checked before and after the reset.
